|--------|-----------------|------------------------|-------|

| **Summer (Jun‑Aug)** | Hot, very humid, monsoon rains | 26–34 °C | July/August can see heavy downpours; humidity can feel oppressive. |

| **Winter (Dec‑Feb)** | Cool, dry, occasional fog | 10–18 °C | Nights can drop to 5–8 °C; mornings may feel chilly. |
